style.styleTitle: Nkuku Set of 3 Sangala Christmas Baubles
style.toneOfVoice: Hand-sculpted from wire in a striking star shape, our Sangala wire baubles have a linked design which is beautifully complemented by an attractive brass finish. This unique combination of soft curves along with industrial elements, style and texture, adds character to any space. These baubles are adorned with green velvet ties to add a hint of Christmas colour to a delicate, simple design. Each Sari tie is one of a kind, so the piece you receive will vary slightly from the images shown, due to its individual character and handmade. Dimensions(mm): . Height: 120 . Width: 120 . Depth: 5.
